digest.component_or_area: reconciliation coordinator for non-create atomic operations
propositions: Compound legacy dispatch replays successful early work and conflates applied/deferred/failed outcomes, requiring a provider-neutral coordinator with normalized dispositions (applied, recovered, deferred, failed, skipped).

The coordinator must execute atomic non-create postconditions (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict) in dependency order through the S1 retry budget without replaying compound mutations.

Late failure in a multi-step plan must preserve proven earlier postconditions and record per-ticket outcomes; re-observation and planning of remaining drift occurs in the next reconcile pass, not mid-execution.

Delete operations already gone must be treated as idempotent success; ticket-local 404 and permanent 4xx failures must isolate the ticket scope, while authoritative broad failures stop only their declared scope.

The coordinator produces fine-grained Disposition per ticket, which projects onto five exact non-overlapping outcome buckets (applied, recovered, deferred, failed, skipped) for per-ticket tallies without implementing fuse thresholds.
